name: hudcade
description: A pixel-art HUD for Claude Code: context, cost, cache, agents and rate limits at a glance, little 8-bit scenes while Claude thinks, and Telegram notifications.

hud.title: HUD band
hud.description: Show model, effort, cost, context, rate limits, git and session/agent progress above the prompt.

statusLine.title: Status line
statusLine.description: Show a compact line under the prompt: model, effort, context, cost and 5-hour/7-day usage.

spinner.title: Pixel spinner
spinner.description: Replace the working spinner with a little 8-bit scene that reacts to what Claude is doing (terminal only).

spinnerScene.title: Spinner scene
spinnerScene.description: Which scene the spinner plays; random picks a different one each turn.

ctxWarnPercent.title: Context warning %
ctxWarnPercent.description: Context usage at which the HUD turns yellow and shows a toast.

ctxCriticalPercent.title: Context critical %
ctxCriticalPercent.description: Context usage at which the HUD turns red and shows a toast.

notify.title: Telegram notifications
notify.description: Send Telegram messages when a turn completes, needs your approval, or fails.

notifyMinTurnSeconds.title: Notify: minimum turn seconds
notifyMinTurnSeconds.description: Skip completion messages for turns shorter than this; 0 sends every turn.

notifyBlocklist.title: Notify: blocked projects
notifyBlocklist.description: Space-separated project folder names that never notify.

telegramBotToken.title: Telegram bot token
telegramBotToken.description: Bot token from @BotFather. When unset, ~/.claude/hooks/.telegram.env is read instead.

telegramChatId.title: Telegram chat id
telegramChatId.description: Chat that receives the messages. When unset, ~/.claude/hooks/.telegram.env is read instead.
